vc_sentences: Casilla 11 Corporate name and the signature-line 'Payer or withholding agent name': Field Explanation now points to Company.Legal_Name (RUT casilla 35) and warns that the client's payroll organisation label carries the company-code prefix '1764 - ' and is not a reliable source of the RUT name.

Casilla 24 Employee document type: Field Explanation now records that the client employee master has no document-type field but four document columns (14 of 261 employees with more than one filled) and requires an explicit Employee.Document_Type; mapping of the client columns to the Form 220 codes raised as a query.

Casilla 25 Employee identification number: Field Explanation now names the client document-number source, warns that 'ID Number' is the internal employee number, states that 'EE Citizenship Card ID' covers 248 of 261 employees and is blank for most foreigner-card holders, and records that 777 of the 1,038 Accumulated Report payees have no employee-master row.

Casilla 30 Period certified - from: Field Explanation now adds the output format AAAA MM DD and the three client start dates ('Hire Date', 'Original Hire Date' in DD-MM-YYYY, 'Adjusted Service Date' in YYYY-MM-DD; 40 of 261 differ) with the choice left to client confirmation.

Casilla 36 Salary payments: Field Explanation now lists the client salary wage types evidenced, states that the client 'Salary Payment Indicator' flag (set on vacation pay, per diems and the leave payouts 79405-79419, absent on other bonuses) is not the casilla-36 rule, requires an RA-approved wage-type-to-casilla table and a 1 January - 31 December sum.

Casilla 37 Payments made with vouchers, cheques, cards or vales: Field Explanation now records the client's 'Inf.' benefit-in-kind wage types booked as earning plus equal deduction (e.g. 65818 / 21115) and that each must be assigned by the RA to casilla 37, 38 or 46 or to no casilla.

Casilla 38 Excess meal payments over 41 UVT: Field Explanation now names the client meal wage type 65818, the month-by-month test per employee summed over the tax year, and the UVT parameter of the tax year (52,374 for 2026) as the UVT source instead of the accumulated wage type 58001.

Casilla 42 Statutory benefit payments: Field Explanation unchanged; Query to RA extended with the client's 'Salary Payment Indicator' evidence on vacation wage types (79401, 62116, 62150 flagged; 62211, 79403 not) and the questions on casilla 42 versus 36, on 62150 Vacation Bonus and on the purpose of the flag.
Casilla 43 Per diem payments: Field Explanation now names the client per-diem wage types 62805-62808 and states that their 'Salary Payment Indicator' flag does not pull them into casilla 36.

Casilla 46 Other payments: Field Explanation now lists the client earning wage types with no evident dedicated casilla (allowances, expatriate items, stock awards, dismissal indemnities, leave payout) and requires an explicit wage-type-to-casilla table with no earning wage type unassigned; placement raised as a query.

Casilla 47 Severance savings and interest paid to the employee: Field Explanation now names the client payment wage types 62110, 62117, 62126 (mainly January and March) and 62127 (January interest) and excludes the provision and balance wage types.

Casilla 49 Severance savings deposited to the fund: Field Explanation now names the client deposit wage type 25827 (mirrored by 65805, take one), paid in February, excludes the provision wage types and records the tax year of the February deposit as an open point; query added.

Casilla 50 Retirement, old-age or invalidity pensions: Field Explanation now records that the client pays pensions directly (62154, 491 payees not in the employee master; 62153, 62151, 62152, 62115, 62830, 62155 to be confirmed), that 330 of 491 pension rows carry a different payee in 'Beneficiary National Id' whose nature (substitute pensioner or third-party payee) is unconfirmed, and that pensioner deductions 21645-21647 / 21643 feed casillas 53-54; queries added.

Casilla 53 Mandatory health contributions borne by the employee: Field Explanation now names wage type 2554 (and 21645 / 21646 / 21647 for pension payees) and warns that the client's Base of Withholding contributions column is the sum of health, pension and solidarity (2554 + 2556 + 2553 for 261 of 261 employees in September 2026).

Casilla 54 Mandatory pension and solidarity-fund contributions: Field Explanation now names wage types 2556 and 2553 (and 21643 for pension payees) and states that the client's combined contributions column cannot split casillas 53 and 54.

Casilla 56 Voluntary contributions to voluntary pension funds: Field Explanation now names the six client FVOL wage types (25811-25815, 25823; September 2026 sum equals 'Contribution APV' for 261 of 261), flags the institutional-plan wage types and the RAIS / voluntary-fund tag as open, and lists 21193 Foncoltabaco as an employee-fund contribution; queries added.

Casilla 57 AFC account contributions: Field Explanation now names the client wage types 25800-25808 (one per receiving bank; September 2026 sum equals 'Contribution AFC' for 260 of 261), flags the AFC refund 62839 for RA confirmation and excludes the aggregated 'CARGA MASIVA AFC' upload as a source.

Casilla 60 Withholding on labour and pension income: Field Explanation now maps the withholding practised to wage types 2552, 21129 (terminations) and 21140 (retirees), excludes the notional 21330 / 25834, flags 25832 / 65832 / 25833 for RA decision, records the client's WITH / WITHOUT CONTRIBUTION results as an open choice and excludes CONTINGENT WITHHOLDING; query added.
